_note: Youth Strategic Forum, Dubai 2026 — event rundown (Sep 22–25, 2026). Day-level structure and start times sourced from the CSCD marketing site's Agenda section (cscd_website/src/components/events/ysf-dubai-2026/AgendaSection.tsx).
